horizonDefinition: y of the far ground or sea line (eye level), 0 = top of the picture, 1 = bottom; read off each picture on a 5% grid, +-0.02. `skyline` (where given) is where the land silhouette meets the sky across the middle half. `horizonDerived` is what the manifest fields alone imply (spec 1.5: horizon ~57% up the desktop half; phone mapped y -> 0.25 + y/2; a panorama's focal y); `scan` is an automatic sky/ground step scan, kept as a cross-check only (it often locks onto a ridge or a foreground water edge).
